preconditions.description: The number of parts n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of ropes m is between 0 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(v) == n and all(0 <= x <= 100000 for x in v)
preconditions.description: The list of energy values v has length n, and each value is between 0 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == m and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v_node <= n and u != v_node for u, v_node in edges)
preconditions.description: The list of edges has length m, and each edge connects two distinct parts within the valid range [1, n].
Every pair of parts is linked by at most one rope (no duplicate edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == str(sum(v[i-1] + v[j-1] for i, j in edges))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum total energy, which equals the sum of the energy values of both endpoints for every rope in the graph.
